## Triage policy

Three rules, applied in this order:

1. **Block** — the code is wrong *now* in some environment (machine-specific, timezone-dependent, event-loop-blocking under load), or it is new code that lands a high-severity structural hazard with no test protecting it.
2. **Warn** — real risk, but it degrades *future* edits rather than current behaviour. Fix in a follow-up, don't hold the PR.
3. **Ignore** — naming/asset/hygiene noise, or low-confidence findings that a fresh repo can't yet distinguish from work-in-progress.

**One caveat on the scores before reading them:** every finding in this report has `churn: 0`, `blast_radius: 0`, `blast_radius_importers: 0`, `recency: 0`. That's expected — this is an empty baseline, so there's no git history and no import graph to inflate anything. The consequence is that `agent_risk` is compressed into a narrow 0.08–0.44 band and is doing much less discriminating work than it would on a live repo. I've weighted `severity` × `confidence` × *"does this break outside the author's laptop"* more heavily, and used `agent_risk` to break ties.

---

## Block merge (9)

| # | Finding | Sev | agent_risk | Why it blocks |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `crime_00017` | Localhost-on-Disk — `/Users/andrew/dev/crimes/schema.json` @ `src/api/files.ts:9` | 0.6 med | 0.30 | Hard defect, `confidence 0.9`. Path exists on exactly one machine; every other dev, CI runner and deploy fails. `effort: quick`. Cheapest possible block. |
| `crime_00016` | Dev-Server URL — `localhost:3000` @ `src/api/files.ts:8` | 0.6 med | 0.30 | Same class: works only against whichever dev server is up. `confidence 0.9`, `effort: quick`. Shipping this is shipping a broken prod build. |
| `crime_00010` | Half-UTC, Half-Local @ `src/date.ts:9,41` | **0.8 high** | 0.36 | `getUTCFullYear()` and `getMonth()` on the same receiver — output silently differs by the host's UTC offset. Highest-severity correctness bug in the report; wrong answers, not ugly code. |
| `crime_00012` | Timezone Roulette @ `src/date.ts:29,33` | 0.6 med | 0.35 | `confidence 0.9`. `"2026-12-25T07:00:00"` parses to different instants per runtime. Same cluster as above; fix in one pass. |
| `crime_00018` | DST-Naive Day Math @ `src/date.ts:52` | 0.6 med | 0.30 | `+ 86400000` drifts an hour on transition days. Combined with the two above, `src/date.ts` cannot be trusted for billing periods. |
| `crime_00001` | Temporal Recklessness — 8× clock reads @ `src/date.ts` | **0.8 high** | **0.44** | Highest `agent_risk` in the report and high severity. It's also *why* the three findings above are unverifiable: with no injectable clock, no test can pin a moment and prove the timezone fixes work. Blocking this is what makes the rest of the date cluster fixable. |
| `crime_00005` | God Function — `generateInvoice`, 204 lines @ `src/billing.ts:50` | **0.9 high** | 0.38 | Highest `severity` × `confidence 0.95` in the report, 3.4× threshold. I'd normally warn on structure, but this is *new* code on an empty baseline — there's no "it was already like that" defence, and `effort: small` (extract helpers). Blocking now is far cheaper than after it accretes callers. |
| `crime_00025` | Test That Proves Nothing — 0 assertions @ `src/billing.test.ts:4` | 0.45 med | 0.27 | Low scores, but read it with `crime_00005`: the *only* test file for the 204-line invoice engine asserts nothing. `agent_risk` understates this badly — a green suite that proves nothing is worse than no suite, for humans and agents alike. |
| `crime_00015` | False Identity — `calculateRefundPreview` @ `src/billing.ts:40` | 0.55 med | 0.31 | `confidence 0.8`. A function named `…Preview` calls `saveRefundAudit` and `sendRefundEmail`. A caller — or an agent — reasonably treats it as pure and invokes it to render a UI, mailing a customer about a refund that never happens. Money-touching side effect behind a safe-sounding name. |

**Blocking theme:** two files. `src/date.ts` (4 findings) and `src/billing.ts` (3 findings, plus its test). That's the real message to the PR author — not nine separate tickets.

---

## Warn (18)

| # | Finding | Sev | agent_risk | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `crime_00003` | Missing Agent Context (no AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md) | 0.6 med | **0.42** | 2nd-highest `agent_risk`, and `confidence 0.9`. Repo declares a `bin` with no way for an agent to discover commands. Warn only because it blocks nothing at runtime — but it's the highest-leverage `effort: small` item here. |
| `crime_00002` | Return Shape Roulette — `resolvePaymentResult` | 0.3 low | **0.43** | The clearest case for not collapsing `agent_risk` into severity: locally trivial, but 3 return shapes with **0% key overlap** means every caller and every agent guesses the contract. Warn at low severity, prioritise like a medium. |
| `crime_00004` | String Sprinkles — `"enterprise"` × 4 files | 0.5 med | 0.42 | Policy literal already spread across `src`, `src/api`, `src/jobs`, `src/ui`. Not wrong yet; becomes duplicated policy on the next edit. |
| `crime_00006` | Duplicated Navigation Source — `/settings/billing` | 0.6 med | 0.38 | Two nav files, two labels (Plans / Billing). Stale-on-one-edit. |
| `crime_00007` | Route Metadata Drift — `/settings/billing` | 0.6 med | 0.38 | Four competing names for one destination (`PricingPage`, `Plans`, `Subscription`, `Billing`). Same root cause as above — one fix, one follow-up. |
| `crime_00013` | Temporal Recklessness — 7× clock reads @ `src/billing.ts` | 0.6 med | 0.34 | Warn rather than block only because it rides along with the `crime_00001` clock injection. If that lands, this is nearly free. |
| `crime_00008` | Sync I/O in Hot Path @ `src/api/files.ts:12–15` | 0.4 low | 0.38 | `confidence 0.9`, async counterparts exist for all three. Blocks the event loop per call — I'd block this if the file were on a request path; there's no evidence here that it is. |
| `crime_00009` | Option Bag Junk Drawer — `describeCheckout` | 0.3 low | 0.38 | 6 implicit property reads. Agents can't tell which fields are required. |
| `crime_00014` | Unfinished Business — 14 markers @ `src/todo.ts` | 0.4 med | 0.32 | 411 markers/1k LOC (41× threshold). Nothing here signals which logic is load-bearing. Triage or delete. |
| `crime_00019` | Concept Alias Drift — tenant/account/org/team/workspace | 0.55 med | 0.30 | Four names for one concept across 5 files. Pick the canonical term before the vocabulary sets. |
| `crime_00020` | Logic in the Alibi @ `src/billing.ts:39` | 0.5 med | 0.30 | *"Only owners can refund enterprise plans unless billing support approves"* — a real authorisation rule living in a comment, with the domain terms absent from nearby code. Warn now; if a later PR touches refunds, this becomes a block. |
| `crime_00032` | SVG With Embedded Raster | **0.75 high** | 0.24 | High severity, `confidence 0.95` — but it's an asset-quality defect, not a behaviour one. Good example of severity and merge-impact diverging; nothing breaks. |
| `crime_00035` | God File — `src/billing.ts`, 311 lines | 0.6 med | 0.18 | Only 1.0× threshold and lowest `agent_risk` of the mediums. Splitting `generateInvoice` (`crime_00005`) likely resolves it for free. |
| `crime_00026` | Date String Sewing @ `src/date.ts:41` | 0.3 low | 0.26 | Part of the `date.ts` sweep. |
| `crime_00027` | Host-Locale Drift @ `src/date.ts:46` | 0.3 low | 0.26 | Same sweep — output varies by runtime locale. |
| `crime_00023` | Temporal Recklessness — 1× @ `src/api/state.ts:18` | 0.35 low | 0.28 | Single call; rides along with clock injection. |
| `crime_00033` | Docs-Code Drift — `docs/teams.md → ./setup.md` | 0.35 low | 0.24 | `confidence 0.9`. Dead link an agent will follow. One-line fix. |
| `crime_00034` | Test That Proves Nothing — weak matcher, "creates an invoice" | 0.25 low | 0.23 | Weaker sibling of `crime_00025`. Fix in the same pass. |

---

## Ignore (10)

| # | Finding | Sev | agent_risk | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `crime_00029` | Orphaned Destination — `/account/subscription` | 0.4 low | 0.26 | `confidence 0.65`. On a PR that *is* the initial commit, "unreachable" and "not wired up yet" are indistinguishable. Re-run after nav lands. |
| `crime_00030` | Orphaned Destination — `/team` | 0.4 low | 0.26 | Same. |
| `crime_00031` | Orphaned Destination — `/workspace/members` | 0.4 low | 0.26 | Same. All three are honest detections that the baseline can't yet adjudicate. |
| `crime_00011` | Negative Flag Maze — `!disableBilling && !skipRetry` | 0.25 low | 0.36 | Highest `agent_risk` of the ignores, but a 2-flag condition is legible. Revisit if a third flag appears. |
| `crime_00022` | Unprefixed Boolean × 3 @ `src/api/state.ts` | 0.3 low | 0.29 | Style. Enforce via lint config, not merge gate. |
| `crime_00028` | Unprefixed Boolean × 2 @ `src/petty.ts:34` | 0.3 low | 0.26 | Same. |
| `crime_00024` | Plural Mismatch — `users: User`, `invoice: Invoice[]` | 0.3 low | 0.28 | Self-flagged "v1 detector"; naming only. |
| `crime_00036` | Icon-Sized Raster — 32×32 PNG | 0.35 low | 0.16 | Asset preference. |
| `crime_00037` | Oversized Raster — 254 KB | 0.4 low | 0.14 | Lowest rung of its own severity ladder (low ≥ 200 KB). Page-weight budget item, not a review gate. |
| `crime_00038` | Unfinished Business — 4 markers @ `src/billing.ts` | 0.2 low | **0.08** | 12.9/1k LOC against a threshold of 10 — barely over, and the lowest `agent_risk` in the report. Noise. |

---

## Verdict

**Do not merge.** 9 blockers, but only 3 pieces of work: fix `src/date.ts` (inject a clock, pick one time domain, parse with explicit zones), split `generateInvoice` and give it a test that asserts something, and lift the two hardcoded environment literals out of `src/api/files.ts`. All nine are `effort: quick` or `small`.

18 warnings go to a follow-up issue — `crime_00003` (add `AGENTS.md`) and `crime_00002` (name the return shape) first, since they carry the highest `agent_risk` in the report and are the cheapest.

10 ignored, of which the 3 orphaned destinations should be re-checked once navigation exists rather than dismissed permanently.
